lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Kell, 2064. The six timber buildings are still here, and around them: terraces cut into the slope, solar sails on the ridge, and a water system built out of salvage by somebody who clearly enjoyed the problem.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: About forty people live here. None of them appear in any census, which in this century is not an oversight. It is the entire point of the place.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Oh. Oh, they kept the orchard.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Those are the same trees. Not the same kind of tree — the same trees, from the cuttings that were in the ground when I left the chapel this morning. Two centuries, and four hundred metres, and I am not equal to it.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: Off-grid, unregistered, and upslope of everything so you see them coming. My lot didn't invent any of that. We inherited it off people like this and then we told ourselves we'd thought of it.
